milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the potted bamboo. target=[3,1,8] matches the /setblock ~3 ~1 ~8 command placing the potted bamboo. max_distance=5 ensures the player must walk from spawn (~8.6 blocks away) to within 5 blocks of the target, meaning they must be at the structure entrance or inside it. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the potted bamboo, not just standing nearby facing away.
